name: Richard
source:
The Guardian of War. The Almighty Richard is a creature that transcends the universe. Multiple gods have come to him for help in order to keep peace in their realms. He resides in the End of Times alongside [url=/c171502]the Guru of Time[/url], who often visits him to give him headpats and scratches.

[In game description]
